evidence: Synthetic browser controller/binding and layout checks only; no native IPC, persistence, execution or OS release qualification.
checks: Click-to-connect atomically moves exact source piece; undo/redo restores same draft without native calls.
Right-click and Shift+F10 share menu; End and Escape navigation restores origin focus.
Real browser drag/drop moves the piece; undo restores exact BOM/CRLF source range.
Cancelled internal drag cannot authorize a later external file drop.
Blank-area, text-field activation and Tab dismiss contextual menu without losing focus.
Stale source connection rejected; source menu assignment and source actions restore meaningful focus.
Explicit remove exposes unassigned range; source port reassigns exact section.
Already assigned source cannot silently move, duplicate or replace through a port.
Unapplied fields block structural edits; Apply then move/undo preserves authored text and reason without positional cache corruption.
External single-field update and undo refresh committed A while preserving unrelated unsaved B through repeated tab renders.
Source assignment cannot remap unapplied B text onto A; after Cancel, range splitting keeps authored fields aligned.
Confirmed discard clears caches; whitespace-only new text also blocks destructive structural edits.
All graph editing, menus and history remain local; no preview/save/provider/native write invoked.
